_comment: Items. tags are what an item can do; obstacles ask for tags. quality ranks tools for the same tag. All descriptions are proposed text.

torch.name: Torch
torch.desc: A heavy rubber torch. The beam is yellow and it buzzes when you shake it.

battery.name: Batteries
battery.desc: Two fat batteries in a paper sleeve.

lighter.name: Lighter
lighter.desc: A brass petrol lighter, nearly dry.

screwdriver.name: Screwdriver
screwdriver.desc: Flat-head. The handle's been mended with tape.

hairpin.name: Hairpins
hairpin.desc: Three black hairpins on a card.

hammer.name: Claw hammer
hammer.desc: Heavy in the head. Good for nails, or for the other thing.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.desc: Forty centimetres of iron, flattened at both ends.

bolt_cutters.name: Bolt cutters
bolt_cutters.desc: Long-handled. The jaws are nicked but they bite.

pills.name: Marta's pills
pills.desc: A brown bottle. The label's been scratched off. They make everything quieter.

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.desc: A clean roll of bandage, still in its paper.

key_flat47.name: Keys to 47
key_flat47.desc: Two keys on a ring with a plastic fish.

key_padlock.name: Small brass key
key_padlock.desc: A small key with a cardboard tag: 48.

key_storage.name: Key with blue tape
key_storage.desc: A long key, blue tape wrapped round the bow.

revolver.name: Revolver
revolver.desc: A Nagant revolver. Seven chambers, loaded one at a time through the gate.

ammo.name: Revolver rounds
ammo.desc: Loose 7.62 mm Nagant rounds, the bullet sunk inside the case.

music_box.name: Music box
music_box.desc: A tin music box with a crank. A little girl painted on the lid, half rubbed away.

alarm_clock.name: Alarm clock
alarm_clock.desc: Wind-up, two bells. It still keeps time. Wind it and set it down somewhere.

key_apt13.name: Key, tagged 13
key_apt13.desc: A Yale key on a split ring. A cardboard tag: 13.
